title: Vintage Gibson SG Standard Value Guide: Prices By Year
description: See vintage Gibson SG Standard values by year through 1979. Joe explains the era ranges, original parts, condition and case details behind each appraisal.
h1: Vintage Gibson SG Standard Value Guide
alt: Cherry SG Standard body with two humbuckers, four knobs and a sideways vibrato in a red-lined case

faqs.q: How Much Is A Vintage Gibson SG Standard Worth?
faqs.a: Vintage Gibson SG Standard reference values run from $2,400 to $3,000 for typical 1970s guitars to $13,500 to $25,000 for early small-guard examples, as of October 2026. I list each year from 1961 through 1979 below, with separate comparisons for the major configurations.

faqs.q: Why Do Several Years Show The Same Value Range?
faqs.a: The repeated figures are shared era references based on at least three independent completed sales per comparison group. They aren't separate statistical estimates for every year. I use the guitar's exact configuration, condition and originality to refine that starting range rather than inventing an annual premium.

faqs.q: What Condition Do The Price Ranges Assume?
faqs.a: Read the condition notes for the applicable era. Some groups cover clean original guitars, while others allow normal playing wear, a quality refret or disclosed minor parts changes. Case originality also varies. A full refinish, structural repair or replacement pickup requires a different comparison.

faqs.q: Is A Dealer Offer The Same As The Published Range?
faqs.a: It isn't. The table describes completed-sale comparisons before shipping and tax. A buying offer also accounts for the instrument's condition, selling costs, preparation and the dealer's margin. I explain an offer for the actual guitar rather than promising the top of a general range.

faqs.q: Does A Quality Refret Change The Collector Category?
faqs.a: A quality refret is accepted maintenance and preserves the all-original classification of an otherwise all-original guitar. It takes the instrument out of the museum-quality category. Neck reshaping is a separate alteration.
